verdict.rationale: Zamzar's web interface says users can "pick your files" (plural) and convert them, and the service claims capacity for "1 file or 10,000". That is thin evidence of multi-file conversion as a product feature. The API is documented only as per-file jobs, which a developer would have to loop over, so it is a building block rather than a batch run. missing for 10: documented batch/folder conversion in a single run, per-file status or result reporting for a batch, independent or hands-on corroboration.
